key_points: GLW has risen 32.5% over the past year, driven by AI infrastructure demand and strong optical communications growth.
Recent analyst commentary questions upside, with a price target cut to $120 by Bernstein.
Institutional ETFs have added roughly $48 million of GLW shares, indicating continued demand.
No material earnings surprises, regulatory issues, or M&A activity reported.
Valuation concerns and modest analyst downgrades temper the bullish momentum.
